title: I have ... / I've got ...
summary: Обладание и характеристики: **I have = I've got** («у меня есть»). Две формы значат одно и то же, но строятся по-разному в отрицании и вопросе.
ru:
## Две формы — одно значение
Чтобы сказать «у меня есть», в английском есть два способа: **have** и **have got**.
> I **have** blue eyes. = I'**ve got** blue eyes. — У меня голубые глаза.
> Tim **has** two sisters. = Tim **has got** two sisters. — У Тима две сестры.
> Our car **has** four doors. = Our car **has got** four doors.

## Какая форма с каким подлежащим
- **I / we / you / they**: **have** или **have got** (краткая: **I've got, we've got, you've got, they've got**)
- **he / she / it**: **has** или **has got** (краткая: **he's got, she's got, it's got**)
> Diane isn't well. She'**s got** a headache. — Дайана плохо себя чувствует. У неё болит голова.
> They like animals. They'**ve got** a horse and three dogs. — Они любят животных. У них лошадь и три собаки.

## Отрицание и вопрос с have got
Вспомогательный глагол — сам **have / has**:
> I **haven't got** a car. — У меня нет машины.
> It **hasn't got** a garden. — У него нет сада.
> **Have** you **got** a camera? — У тебя есть камера?
> **Has** Ann **got** a car? — У Анны есть машина?
> What **have** you **got** in your bag? — Что у тебя в сумке?

## Краткие ответы
> Have you got a camera? — **Yes, I have.** / **No, I haven't.**
> Has Ann got a car? — **Yes, she has.** / **No, she hasn't.**
После **Yes** краткую форму не используем: не ~~Yes, I've.~~

## Отрицание и вопрос с have (вариант do)
С **have** (без got) используем **do / does**:
> They **don't have** any children. (= haven't got)
> It **doesn't have** a garden. (= hasn't got)
> **Does** Ann **have** a car? (= Has Ann got a car?)
> How much money **do** you **have**? (= have you got)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Do you have got a car?~~ → **Have** you got a car? **или** **Do** you **have** a car?
- ~~She haven't got a car.~~ → She **hasn't** got a car.
- ~~He has got not a camera.~~ → He **hasn't got** a camera.
- ~~Yes, I've.~~ → Yes, I **have**.
en:
## Two ways to say the same thing
We use **have** or **have got** to talk about what people own, their family, and how they look or feel.
> I **have** blue eyes. = I'**ve got** blue eyes.
> Tim **has** two sisters. = Tim **has got** two sisters.
> Our car **has** four doors. = Our car **has got** four doors.

## Which form?
- **I / we / you / they**: **have** or **have got** (short: **I've got, we've got, you've got, they've got**)
- **he / she / it**: **has** or **has got** (short: **he's got, she's got, it's got**)
> Diane isn't well. She'**s got** a headache.
> They like animals. They'**ve got** a horse and three dogs.

## Negative and question with have got
The helper is **have / has** itself:
> I **haven't got** a car.
> It **hasn't got** a garden.
> **Have** you **got** a camera?
> **Has** Ann **got** a car?
> What **have** you **got** in your bag?

## Short answers
> Have you got a camera? — **Yes, I have.** / **No, I haven't.**
> Has Ann got a car? — **Yes, she has.** / **No, she hasn't.**
Not ~~Yes, I've.~~

## With do / does
With **have** (no got) we use **do / does**:
> They **don't have** any children. (= haven't got)
> It **doesn't have** a garden. (= hasn't got)
> **Does** Ann **have** a car? (= Has Ann got a car?)

## Common mistakes
- ~~Do you have got a car?~~ → **Have** you got a car? **or** **Do** you **have** a car?
- ~~She haven't got a car.~~ → She **hasn't** got a car.
- ~~Yes, I've.~~ → Yes, I **have**.
structure:
## Утверждение
| Подлежащее | have / have got | Краткая форма |
|---|---|---|
| I / we / you / they | have = have got | I've got, we've got, you've got, they've got |
| he / she / it | has = has got | he's got, she's got, it's got |

## Отрицание
| Подлежащее | have got | have (с do) |
|---|---|---|
| I / we / you / they | haven't got | don't have |
| he / she / it | hasn't got | doesn't have |

## Вопрос
| Подлежащее | have got | have (с do) |
|---|---|---|
| I / we / you / they | **Have** you got a pen? | **Do** you have a pen? |
| he / she / it | **Has** she got a pen? | **Does** she have a pen? |

## Краткие ответы
| | Да | Нет |
|---|---|---|
| Have I / we / you / they got ...? | Yes, I / we / you / they have. | No, I / we / you / they haven't. |
| Has he / she / it got ...? | Yes, he / she / it has. | No, he / she / it hasn't. |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **have got / has got** + что-то
> She **has got** a bike. · They **haven't got** a car. · **Have** you **got** a pen?

## Важно
- got здесь **не** значит «получил» — это часть формы «у меня есть».
- **have got** используем для обладания; для действий (have breakfast, have a shower) — только **have** (см. unit 57).

exercises.title: Краткие формы
exercises.instruction: Напишите краткую форму (**we've got**, **he hasn't got** и т. д.).

items.text: she has not got → {{she hasn't got|she's not got}}
I have not got → {{I haven't got|I've not got}}

exercises.title: have got: утверждение, отрицание, вопрос
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **have / has / haven't / hasn't** в нужную форму.

items.text: I {{have|'ve}} got a brother, but I {{haven't|have not}} got a sister.
{{Have}} you got a passport? — Yes, I {{have}}.
It's a nice flat, but it {{hasn't|has not}} got a balcony.
{{Has}} your father got a car? — No, he {{hasn't|has not}}.
We {{haven't|have not}} got any milk. Let's go to the shop.

items.q: She ___ a car. She goes by bus.
Have you got a pen? — Yes, ___.
Has she got a car? — No, ___.
Do you have a sister? — Yes, ___.
Have they got any children? — No, ___.
Does he have a laptop? — No, ___.

answers: Has your father got a car?

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Напишите о себе, используя **I've got / I haven't got**. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I've got one brother and two sisters.
I haven't got long hair. I've got short hair.

items.prompt: What have you got in your bag?
items.sample: I've got a phone, a notebook and keys.
